title: THE COMPREHENSIVE SPEED LIMIT ORDINANCE OF DAVAO CITY
enacting_clause: BE IT ORDAINED BY THE SANGGUNIANG PANLUNGSOD OF DAVAO CITY, IN SESSION ASSEMBLED, THAT:
judicial_case: Davao City Speed Limit Enforcement under Joint DOTr-DPWH-DILG JAO 2018-01
ruling: Valid Delegated Local Speed Setting under National Transport Guidelines (Upheld)
superior_national_law: Republic Act No. 4136 §35, §38; Joint DILG-DOTr-DPWH JAO 2018-01

operative_sections.SECTION 1. TITLE: This Ordinance shall be known as the 'Comprehensive Speed Limit Ordinance of Davao City'.
operative_sections.SECTION 4. SPEED LIMIT CLASSIFICATION: Classifies city roads into Open Roads (80 kph private / 50 kph trucks and buses), Through Streets (40 kph / 30 kph), City Streets (30 kph), and Crowded Residential/School Streets (20 kph).
operative_sections.SECTION 6. SPEED DETECTION MACHINERY: Authorizes CTTMO to utilize DOST-calibrated radar speed cameras and automated speed enforcement tools.
